units.name: Department of Management, Marketing, Entrepreneurship, and Fire & Emergency Services Administration
units.school: Broadwell College of Business and Economics
units.evidence: The official Supply Chain Management and Technology bachelor’s page and business college department list explicitly identify this department host. The programme teaches procurement, inventory, transport, distribution, logistics networks, operations planning and control, ERP systems and supply chain project management. The degree is not treated as a department.

decisions.reason: Supply Chain Management is an official bachelor’s programme hosted by the verified full department, not a separately named department.

Official Information Systems and Business Analytics is a B.S. programme in the Accounting, Finance, Healthcare Administration, and Information Systems department. Its full stated scope concerns information systems, analytics and databases; no separate qualifying Operations unit is established.

The official Healthcare Administration B.S. and Healthcare Management concentration are programmes in the combined Accounting/Finance/Healthcare/IS department. Generic healthcare management, systems thinking and quantitative business tools do not establish a substantive Operations unit.

limitations: Department headings and college navigation give the expanded Management/Marketing/Entrepreneurship/Fire/Emergency Services name; the programme contact section uses a shorter version. No historical rename date or separate organizational entity is inferred.
